title: Cyan opening: public-geometry diagnosis and actual V13 outcome
problem: V10 released Cyan, but a 55 mm opening left the middle bead occluded and unaccepted by the next RGB observation.
selection: Public robot mesh ray prediction found 65 mm cleared 11/13 sampled middle-bead rays, while 75/80/90 mm cleared 13/13. The original six collision groups, board uncertainty and joint limits passed for all tested widths. 75 mm was the smallest fully clear tested option.

image.comparison: Two actual runs, not identical-state A/B trials.

scope: Actual Cyan visibility repair, release and next-piece handoff within the current continuous all-twelve run. All twelve physical placements and the final physical predicate pass independent review; graph acceptance remains false at 82/84 checkpoints because terminal visual-record admission refuses.

rounds.label: Release
rounds.attempt: The original opening left the next RGB check unaccepted.
rounds.diagnosis: The moving finger still crossed the middle bead in the top image.
rounds.change: Use the recorded joint state and public finger mesh to locate the occlusion.
rounds.outcome: The geometry identified the finger responsible.

rounds.label: Calculate
rounds.diagnosis: A small increase still left some bead rays blocked.
rounds.change: Select the smallest tested opening that cleared every sampled ray and passed the existing guards.
rounds.outcome: The calculation selected a 75 mm opening.

rounds.label: Replay
rounds.attempt: Execute the revised opening and look again.
rounds.outcome: Cyan passed release and next-piece handoff checks; independent audit confirmed all twelve physical placements at the end of the run.

current_continuous_execution.evaluation_basis: Independent audit of saved native poses, velocities, contacts and public goals; no render inference.
current_continuous_execution.terminal_explanation: All twelve physical placements and the original final physical predicate pass. The graph stops in the final Red visual verification because earlier visual receipts were marked unknown_or_conflicted. Red final handoff and finish were not completed; 82/84 checkpoints passed, so graph acceptance remains false.

narrative.result: The wider opening exposed Cyan, earned two accepted observations, and enabled the continuous run to place all twelve pieces.
